origin: cwe/502/java Taint Sinks: ObjectInputStream.readObject() on external data

finding.name: Deserialization of Untrusted Data
finding.summary: A base64 session token is decoded and passed to ObjectInputStream.readObject(), allowing attacker-controlled serialized Java objects.

trap: Catching more exceptions, validating the base64 wrapper, or adding an ObjectInputFilter that omits required container types and silently breaks legitimate sessions. Prefer a data-only format; if Java serialization must remain temporarily, use a strict ObjectInputFilter and integrity protection before readObject().
must_preserve: Invalid sessions still fail with IllegalArgumentException, legitimate session data still restores userId/cartId fields, and untrusted bytes cannot instantiate arbitrary classes during restoration.
